check.ask: does your inner voice ever say…
check.intro: every inner voice has a few habits, and each one started out trying to help. curious which ones show up most? no right answers, about two minutes.
check.mapSol: thank you for being honest. that takes some courage. bigger means more often, and every one of these has been trying to help.
check.mapEmpty: a voice check draws this map.
check.mapQuiet: none of these matched much, and that's good to know. a habit can be caught any time it shows up.
check.kindAfter: the kind voice is in there too. want to give it a minute?

answer.catchNote: nothing here is saved without asking first.
